question: How many orders are in the dataset?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: How many unique customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers

question: How many sellers are based in Sao Paulo state?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'SP'

question: What is the average review score across all reviews?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) FROM reviews

question: How many orders were canceled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

question: Which payment type appears in the most payment records?
sql: SELECT payment_type FROM payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many products have no category?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL

question: What is the highest price paid for a single item?
sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM order_items

question: Which 5 states have the most unique customers?
sql: SELECT customer_state FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many orders are there in each order status?
sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_status

question: What is the average freight value per item?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(freight_value), 2) FROM order_items

question: How many orders were purchased in 2017?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE year(order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017

question: What was total revenue in 2017?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017

question: What are the top 5 product categories by revenue? Use English category names.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY category ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average delivery time in days for delivered orders?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(date_diff('day', CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE), CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE))), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: What percentage of delivered orders arrived late?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: What is the average review score for orders that arrived late?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)

question: Which 10 sellers have the highest revenue?
sql: SELECT oi.seller_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the average order value?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

question: How many orders did customers in Rio de Janeiro state place in 2018?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ' AND year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018

question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2017?
sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE year(order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 GROUP BY month

question: What percentage of payment records are boleto payments?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'boleto' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM payments

question: Which 5 customer cities have the most unique customers?
sql: SELECT customer_city FROM customers GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average number of items per order?
sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) FROM order_items

question: How many different sellers have sold at least one health_beauty product?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty'

question: What was the total freight value across all orders purchased in 2018?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018

question: Which customer state has the longest average delivery time for delivered orders?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY AVG(date_diff('day', CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE), CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE))) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were paid with more than one payment type?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) > 1) t

question: What percentage of unique customers placed more than one order?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) t

question: Among product categories with at least 500 delivered orders, which 5 have the highest late-delivery rate? Use English names.
sql: WITH oc AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS late FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL) SELECT category FROM oc GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500 ORDER BY AVG(late) DESC LIMIT 5

question: What was the month-over-month revenue growth percentage for each month from January to August 2018?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY month), g AS (SELECT month, 100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS growth FROM m) SELECT month, ROUND(growth, 2) FROM g WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-01' AND DATE '2018-08-01'

question: Which sellers have an average review score below 3 across at least 50 reviewed orders?
sql: WITH sr AS (SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id, r.order_id, r.review_id, r.review_score FROM order_items oi JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = oi.order_id) SELECT seller_id FROM sr GROUP BY seller_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 50 AND AVG(review_score) < 3

question: For repeat customers, what is the average number of days between their first and second order?
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS u, o.order_purchase_timestamp AS ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(date_diff('day', CAST(f.ts AS DATE), CAST(s.ts AS DATE))), 2) FROM ranked f JOIN ranked s ON s.u = f.u AND f.rn = 1 AND s.rn = 2

question: Which customer state has delivered orders arriving the most days ahead of the estimated delivery date on average?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY AVG(date_diff('day', CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE), CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE))) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of total revenue comes from the top 100 sellers by revenue?
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY oi.seller_id), r AS (SELECT rev, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rev DESC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 100 THEN rev ELSE 0 END) / SUM(rev), 2) FROM r

question: Across all order items, which product category has the highest freight ratio among categories with at least 1,000 items? Use English names.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many sellers have sold to customers in more than 20 different states?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT oi.seller_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY oi.seller_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_state) > 20) t

question: Show the cumulative number of orders by month for 2017.
sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE)) AS cumulative_orders FROM orders WHERE year(order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 GROUP BY month

question: Which customer spent the most in total on delivered orders?
sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_value) DESC LIMIT 1

question: In which month of 2017 was the late-delivery rate highest?
sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) AS month FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND year(order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 GROUP BY month ORDER BY AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 1
